description: Reads a Node and outputs its X / Y canvas position in metres (val-x / val-y).
instructions: Wire a Node source into the input; this publishes that node's canvas position as `val-x` / `val-y` value outputs, in metres. Wire those into a Point's X / Y (or any value input) to place geometry at the node — the coordinate follows the node when it moves. It has no geometry of its own.
